blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Gujarat's agricultural landscape is supported significantly by major crops and the cooperative dairy sector led by Amul.
Industrial growth is concentrated around major industrial hubs and specialized key industries across the state.
Maritime infrastructure, including major ports, forms a vital foundation for Gujarat's trade and economic expansion.
State-level economic institutions play a central role in driving investment, trade policies, and industrial infrastructure.

blocks.content: Gujarat is one of the most economically developed states in India. It contributes significantly to India's GDP. The state is known as the 'Growth Engine of India.' Gujarat's GSDP (Gross State Domestic Product) is among the top in the country. The state's per capita income is above the national average.

items: GDP contribution: Gujarat contributes about 7–8% of India's GDP
Industrial output: Contributes about 16–18% of India's industrial output
Exports: Gujarat accounts for approximately 22% of India's total exports

cells: Gujarat is India's largest cotton producer; known as 'White Gold'
Major export crop; Anand and Nadiad are major centers
Gujarat is world's largest castor oil producer

blocks.content: Gujarat's cooperative dairy sector is globally renowned. The Anand Milk Union Limited (AMUL) is one of the world's largest dairy cooperatives.

items: Amul was founded in 1946 by Tribhuvandas Kishibhai Patel under Sardar Patel's guidance.

Dr. Verghese Kurien, known as the 'Father of the White Revolution' or 'Milkman of India,' was the architect of Operation Flood, transforming India into the world's largest milk producer. He worked from Anand, Gujarat.
The National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) is headquartered at Anand.
Anand is known as the 'Milk Capital of India.'
Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (GCMMF) markets the Amul brand.

cells: Diamond polishing (85% of world's diamonds), textiles, synthetic fabrics
Engineering goods, auto parts, machine tools, brass goods
Petroleum refining (Reliance Industries — world's largest refinery complex)
Adani Port (India's largest private port), SEZ, power plants

items: Diamond Industry: Surat processes approximately 85–90% of the world's rough diamonds. Over 500,000 artisans work in the industry. Surat is called the 'Diamond City of the World.'
Textile Industry: Ahmedabad was historically the 'Manchester of the East.' Surat is now a major synthetic textile hub. Patan is famous for Patola silk sarees.
Chemical and Petrochemical Industry: Gujarat accounts for about 62% of India's petrochemical production. Reliance Industries' Jamnagar refinery is the world's largest refining complex.
Pharmaceutical Industry: Gujarat is India's leading state for pharmaceutical manufacturing and exports. Ahmedabad, Vadodara, and Ankleshwar are key pharma centers.
Engineering Goods: Rajkot and Ahmedabad are major centers for engineering goods, auto components, and machine tools.
Salt Production: Gujarat produces about 76% of India's salt, primarily from the Rann of Kutch and Little Rann of Kutch.
Exams frequently cover the origin, impact, and cooperative model of Amul within the dairy sector.
Key industrial hubs and major ports in Gujarat are high-yield topics for geography and economy sections.
Questions often test the role of important economic institutions in facilitating trade and industrial development.

blocks.content: Gujarat has the most number of ports among Indian states.

cells: India's largest commercial port by cargo volume
India's largest port by total cargo; renamed Deendayal in 2017

items: National Institute of Design (NID): Ahmedabad — premier design institute.
Indian Institute of Management (IIM-A): Ahmedabad — among the world's top business schools.

GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City): Gandhinagar — India's first operational smart city and international financial services center; houses India's first International Financial Services Centre (IFSC).
Vibrant Gujarat Summit: Biennial global investors summit held in Gandhinagar since 2003; largest investment summit in Asia.
GSFC (Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals): Vadodara — major chemical company.
GSECL (Gujarat State Electricity Corporation Limited): Power generation company.
GNFC (Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals): Bharuch.
